name: Good Cop / Bad Cop Decomposition
stage: De-escalation, Resistance Defusal & Countering Bad Faith
scenario: Counterpart CFO attacks every line item aggressively, while their VP of Product acts as a warm, collaborative partner.
script: "It appears we are working through a classic good-cop/bad-cop dynamic here. Let us bypass the theatrical posture and examine the commercial numbers together."
defense: Split the coalition: your CFO holds the cash line, you see the long-term value; equip you to show the ROI justifies it.
originFull: Cross-Coalition Contrast and Ingroup Formation show that an aggressive negotiator paired with an empathetic partner creates psychological relief that channels concessions toward the "reasonable" partner.
defenseFull: Splitting the coalition: "I recognize your CFO is holding a rigid line on cash flow, while you see the long-term operational value. How can we equip you to help your CFO see that the ROI justifies this investment?"
